name: Blackjack Coach: Learn 21
description: Learn blackjack step by step with Blackjack Coach. Practise hand values, basic strategy, insurance and Hi-Lo card counting. Choose a play, read the explanation and review your mistakes. Use the strategy chart or practise rounds against the dealer at your own pace. The chart teaches fixed six-deck rules: dealer stands on soft 17, double after split and late surrender. Local training works offline; ads need connectivity and spoken questions depend on available device voices. For adults learning the game. No real-money gambling or prizes; practice does not guarantee gambling success.
